<template>
  <el-dialog v-model="dialogVisible" title="添加测试计划" width="600px" :close-on-click-modal="false">
    <el-form :model="form" :rules="rules" ref="formRef" label-width="100px">
      <el-form-item label="计划名称" prop="name">
        <el-input v-model="form.name" />
      </el-form-item>
      <el-form-item label="类型" prop="type">
        <el-input v-model="form.type" />
      </el-form-item>
      <el-form-item label="大小" prop="size">
        <el-input-number v-model="form.size" :min="0" />
      </el-form-item>
      <el-form-item label="时间" prop="time">
        <el-input v-model="form.time" />
      </el-form-item>
      <el-form-item label="数量" prop="num">
        <el-input-number v-model="form.num" :min="1" />
      </el-form-item>
      <el-form-item label="速度" prop="velocity">
        <el-input v-model="form.velocity" />
      </el-form-item>
      <el-form-item label="容器1" prop="container1">
        <el-input v-model="form.container1" />
      </el-form-item>
      <el-form-item label="容器2" prop="container2">
        <el-input v-model="form.container2" />
      </el-form-item>
      <el-form-item label="容器2 IP" prop="container2Ip">
        <el-input v-model="form.container2Ip" />
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>

    <template #footer>
      <el-button @click="dialogVisible = false">取消</el-button>
      <el-button type="primary" @click="submitForm">提交</el-button>
    </template>
  </el-dialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, defineExpose } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'


const dialogVisible = ref(false)
const formRef = ref(null)

const form = ref({
  id: null,
  name: '',
  type: '',
  size: null,
  time: '',
  num: null,
  velocity: '',
  container1: '',
  container2: '',
  container2Ip: '',
})

const rules = {
  name: [{ required: true, message: '请输入名称', trigger: 'blur' }],
  type: [{ required: true, message: '请输入类型', trigger: 'blur' }],
  size: [{ required: true, message: '请输入大小', trigger: 'blur' }],
  time: [{ required: true, message: '请输入时间', trigger: 'blur' }],
  num: [{ required: true, message: '请输入数量', trigger: 'blur' }],
}

const openDialog = () => {
  resetForm()
  dialogVisible.value = true
}

defineExpose({ openDialog })

const submitForm = () => {
  formRef.value.validate(async (valid) => {
    if (valid) {
      try {
        const response = await axios.post('http://localhost:8081/plan/add', form.value)
        if (response.data === '添加成功') {
          ElMessage.success('添加成功')
          dialogVisible.value = false
        } else {
          ElMessage.warning(response.data)
        }
      } catch (error) {
        ElMessage.error('添加失败')
        console.error(error)
      }
    }
  })
}

const resetForm = () => {
  form.value = {
    id: null,
    name: '',
    type: '',
    size: null,
    time: '',
    num: null,
    velocity: '',
    container1: '',
    container2: '',
    container2Ip: '',
  }
}
</script>
